title: Video Understanding Reward Modeling: A Robust Benchmark and Performant Reward Models
abstract: arXiv:2605.07872v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Multimodal reward models have advanced substantially in text and image domains, yet progress in video understanding reward modeling remains severely limited by the lack of robust evaluation benchmarks and high-quality preference data. To address this, we propose a unified framework spanning benchmark design, data construction, and reward model training. We introduce Video Understanding Reward Bench (VURB), a benchmark featuring 2,100 preference pairs with long chain-of-thought reasoning traces (averaging 1,143 tokens) and majority voting evaluation across general, long, and reasoning-oriented video tasks. We further construct Video Understanding Preference Dataset (VUP-35K) via a fully automated pipeline, providing large-scale high-quality supervision for video reward training. Building on the data, we train VideoDRM and VideoGRM, a discriminative and a generative reward model, both achieving state-of-the-art performance on VUR

translated_title: 视频理解奖励建模：一个鲁棒的基准与高性能的奖励模型
translated_abstract: 多模态奖励模型在文本和图像领域已取得长足进展，但视频理解奖励建模的进展仍严重受限于鲁棒评估基准和高质量偏好数据的缺乏。为解决这一问题，我们提出了一个涵盖基准设计、数据构建和奖励模型训练的统一框架。我们引入了视频理解奖励基准（VURB），该基准包含2,100个偏好对，并配有长思维链推理轨迹（平均1,143个token），同时在通用、长视频和推理导向的各类视频任务上采用多数投票进行评估。我们进一步通过全自动流水线构建了视频理解偏好数据集（VUP-35K），为视频奖励模型训练提供大规模高质量监督。基于这些数据，我们训练了判别式奖励模型VideoDRM和生成式奖励模型VideoGRM，两者均在VURB上取得了最先进的性能。
tldr: 该论文提出了包含2,100个长思维链偏好对的视频理解奖励基准VURB，以及通过全自动流水线构建的35K规模偏好数据集VUP-35K，并据此训练出达到最先进性能的判别式（VideoDRM）和生成式（VideoGRM）视频奖励模型。
